summary: Executed backend+frontend validation for local offline simulation, worker runtime, session/report flows, Early routing, and admin access via public preview URL.

critical.issue: Public preview admin login fails with 403 'Invalid request origin.' even when frontend URL origin is configured in backend .env.

minor.issue: Unreachable legacy code remains after immediate return in join handler (dead block from line ~953 onward in backend/server.py).

ui_bugs.issue: Valid password cannot authenticate from browser because backend rejects origin.

integration_issues.issue: Opening /early/console without draft handle redirects to /early (console page testid not rendered).

action_items: Fix admin origin validation through preview ingress/proxy so /api/admin/login accepts real browser requests.
Retest admin settings updates (zombie_count/bot_count) after origin fix.
Review whether /early/console should hard-redirect to /early when no draft exists or show a guided console empty-state.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/admin_auth.py check_origin compares raw header equality; ingress/proxy origin transformations currently break admin auth on public domain.
backend/server.py /api/join contains stale unreachable legacy block after returning local_sessions.create(...); remove to reduce maintenance risk.
Validated: local worker path uses real Pyodide runtime and game.zip modules (no server game.run path required for gameplay tick).
seed_data_creation: Created test-only local DB fixtures for two paid accounts and one unpaid account; also two persistent UI worker test accounts recorded in memory/test_credentials.md. No real payment used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest file added and passing (10/10): session gates, ws contract, report validation, online-count transitions, runtime asset serving, early 503 blocker validation. Browser worker test confirmed real Pyodide startup and two isolated worlds. Remaining blocker is admin login origin rejection on public preview.
rca of the issue: Admin login failure reproduces from both requests and browser: POST /api/admin/login returns 403 Invalid request origin. Root cause likely strict raw origin match in check_origin against headers after ingress/proxy rewriting; although env includes preview origin, effective origin seen by backend differs/absent. Mitigation: normalize/evaluate forwarded origin chain safely (or trusted proxy header strategy) and align with deployed ingress behavior.
